label: PF Backlog 586
title: Eventing SSOT: retire legacy websocket push (frozen dashboard -> SSE)
body:
## Problem / why
core/websocket_manager.py duplicates the push concern in the frozen legacy dashboard.

## Goal / value
Stop extending the legacy WS; migrate its consumers to SSE; retain (never delete) until the new UI lands.

## In scope
- Deprecation note + migration mapping; freeze (legacy_exempt_roots already covers dashboard/).

## Out of scope
- Rewriting the dashboard.

## Acceptance criteria
- No new WS usage; a documented path to SSE; wired_audit unaffected.

## Verification / test plan
- Doc + grep guard that no new WS consumer is added.
